_comment: ComfyUI Workflow B — Planet & Star surface maps via the Flux Equirectangular 360 LoRA (Flux.1-dev base, trigger 'equirectangular 360 degree panorama'). API-format graph: POST to /prompt as {"prompt": <this>}. Flux needs SPLIT loaders (UNETLoader + DualCLIPLoader + VAELoader), NOT CheckpointLoaderSimple. Replace [TYPE_PROMPT] / [TYPE] / [NN] before queueing — see docs/design/ART_PROMPTS.md '### Planet Surface Maps (Flux 360 LoRA)' and '### Star Surface Maps'. Adjust unet/clip/vae/lora filenames to whatever is installed on the host.

_generation_notes.lora: flux_equirectangular_360.safetensors (civitai#735980, ver 823024), trigger 'equirectangular 360 degree panorama', weight 0.5-1.5 (default 0.85)
_generation_notes.base_model: Flux.1-dev — split loaders: UNETLoader (node 4), DualCLIPLoader T5+CLIP-L (node 11), VAELoader Flux ae (node 12). No CFG in the classic sense; distilled guidance set via FluxGuidance (node 13).
_generation_notes.latent_note: Node 5 is EmptySD3LatentImage — Flux uses 16-channel latents, so the plan's 'EmptyLatentImage' must be the SD3 variant or sampling errors on a channel mismatch. Size 2048x1024 = 2:1 equirectangular.
_generation_notes.sampler: KSampler (node 3): steps=30, cfg=2.5, euler/simple. FluxGuidance guidance=2.5 (node 13) drives the distilled guidance; cfg=2.5 lets the negative prompt (node 7) take effect. Drop cfg to 1.0 to ignore the negative and run ~2x faster.
_generation_notes.positive_prompt: Set node 6 text to 'equirectangular 360 degree panorama, [TYPE_PROMPT]' from ART_PROMPTS.md. Negative (node 7) is fixed for all types.
_generation_notes.filename_prefix: Set node 9 to 'planet_maps/[TYPE]_[NN]' for planets (e.g. 'planet_maps/bastions_01') or 'star_maps/[TYPE]_[NN]' for stars (e.g. 'star_maps/yellow_01').
_generation_notes.variants_target: aim for >= 2 variants per planet type (16 planet images) + 1 per star type (4 star images); change node 3 'seed' for each variant
_generation_notes.naming_convention: <type>_0N.jpg — AI-generated variants use _01/_02/_03; Solar System Scope CC BY 4.0 originals keep _04+ (see planet_maps/CREDITS.md)

_sd15_fallback._comment: No-Flux fallback for hosts without Flux.1-dev. Start from workflow_api.json (CheckpointLoaderSimple + KSampler), insert a LoraLoader (node 10 pattern from workflow_zit_nebula.json) and render small, then centre-crop to 2:1.
_sd15_fallback.aspect: render 1:1 (768x768) or 1:2 (512x1024), then centre-crop / pad to 2:1 (2048x1024)
_sd15_fallback.ksampler: steps=28, cfg=7.0, sampler dpmpp_2m, scheduler karras (classic SD1.5 settings)

inputs.text: fisheye, text, watermark, latitude lines, grid, people, faces
